sources.name: Open English Wordnet 2025 (JSON)
sources.attribution: Open English Wordnet 2025, the Open English Wordnet team (McCrae et al.), derived from Princeton WordNet 3.1, Princeton University.
sources.coverage: POS-tagged IPA (GB/US variety as dialect) and sense-level derivational links. OEWN links have no direction: endpoints of kind other are unoriented, written alphabetically, claiming nothing about which word comes from which.

sources.name: etymology-db (Wiktionary etymologies)
sources.attribution: etymology-db by Daniel Roher (droher), parsed from Wiktionary; Wiktionary contributors.
sources.coverage: Explicit ancestry edges reachable from English terms (chains in source order; has_root as relation unknown) and English *_with_root derivations. The source records no uncertainty, so uncertain is false throughout.
sources.notice: The etymology-db dataset (https://github.com/droher/etymology-db) is derived from Wiktionary (https://www.wiktionary.org/), whose text is the work of Wiktionary contributors and is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. sources.name: MorphyNet English inflectional morphology
sources.attribution: MorphyNet, Khuyagbaatar Batsuren, Gábor Bella and Fausto Giunchiglia (SIGMORPHON 2021); from Wiktionary contributors.
sources.coverage: Inflected forms with their UniMorph feature tags, verbatim.
sources.notice:
MorphyNet: a Large Multilingual Database of Derivational and Inflectional Morphology. Khuyagbaatar Batsuren, Gábor Bella and Fausto Giunchiglia. Proceedings of the 18th SIGMORPHON Workshop, 2021. https://github.com/kbatsuren/MorphyNet

sources.name: MorphyNet English derivational morphology
sources.attribution: MorphyNet, Khuyagbaatar Batsuren, Gábor Bella and Fausto Giunchiglia (SIGMORPHON 2021); from Wiktionary contributors.
sources.coverage: Prefix and suffix derivations with both POS and the affix, kept only where the affix attaches to the base by the documented spelling rules; other rows (POS U, empty or non-attaching affix) are skipped and counted in the report.
sources.notice:
MorphyNet: a Large Multilingual Database of Derivational and Inflectional Morphology. Khuyagbaatar Batsuren, Gábor Bella and Fausto Giunchiglia. Proceedings of the 18th SIGMORPHON Workshop, 2021. https://github.com/kbatsuren/MorphyNet

sources.name: Kaikki.org English (Wiktextract)
sources.attribution: Kaikki.org / Wiktextract by Tatu Ylonen, extracted from English Wiktionary; Wiktionary contributors.
sources.coverage: One verified per-word file each: POS-tagged IPA, tagged forms, linked form-of lemmas and morphology-template derivations.
sources.notice: Data extracted by Wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen, https://github.com/tatuylonen/wiktextract) and published at https://kaikki.org/, from English Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org/).
